name: autobot
description: Deterministic job-application autofill Chrome extension, reconstructed from Simplify Copilot and Jobright analysis.

scripts.pack: mkdir -p dist && rm -f dist/autobot-$npm_package_version.zip && (cd autobot && zip -qr ../dist/autobot-$npm_package_version.zip . -x '*.DS_Store' -x 'configs/profile.default.json') && ls -la dist
